name: process_or_flag_structure
description: Reads a global result and then tests a 16-bit field of the structure passed in. When that field is zero it calls another routine on the structure, again on an address range formed from two 16-bit fields, and once more, then returns the saved result; otherwise it sets bit 3 of a flag byte in the structure, calls another routine, and returns zero.

name: return_saved_value_after_calls
description: Saves a global value, calls another routine, then calls a second routine with an address range derived from two 16-bit fields of the structure held in an address register, calls a third routine, and returns the saved global value.

name: decrement_and_finish_structure
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in the structure passed in and stores it back. When the counter reaches zero and bit 3 of a flag byte in the same structure is set, it returns the result of another routine called on the structure; otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero and does nothing else; it takes no arguments.

name: invoke_nonzero_callbacks
description: Calls another routine with the third argument when that argument is non-zero, calls routines with several global values that are non-zero, and calls another routine with the second argument and a flag when that argument is non-zero, with no return value.

name: allocate_info_structure_block
description: Requests an 812-byte block from a library routine and returns zero if the request fails. Otherwise it sets a set of internal pointers into the block, copies fixed blocks of template data from a global variable into several sections, links two of the pointers, and returns one.

name: initialize_info_library_structures
description: Copies a fixed block of template longwords from a global variable into the structure whose base pointer is held in an address register, and stores internal pointers at fixed offsets within it. It then calls another routine twice with the template and two of those pointers, copies more template sections into the regions they point to, and returns one.

name: open_libraries_or_report_failure
description: Calls another routine four times, storing each result in a global variable. A zero first or second result reports failure code 3, a zero third result code 4 and a zero fourth result code 5, each through a second routine, and then the code returns zero; it returns one only when all four results are non-zero, and the referenced text names dos.library.

name: open_three_libraries_indirect
description: Calls a routine held in an address register three times, storing each result in a global variable. A zero first result reports code 3, a zero second result code 4 and a zero third result code 5, each through a routine held in a second address register; it returns one only when all three results are non-zero, and the referenced text names icon.library.

name: open_two_libraries_indirect
description: Calls a routine held in an address register twice, storing each result in a global variable. A zero first result reports code 4 and a zero second result reports code 5, both through a routine held in a second address register; it returns one only when both results are non-zero, and the referenced text names intuition.library.

name: open_one_library_indirect
description: Calls a routine held in an address register once and stores the result in a global variable. If the result is zero it reports code 5 through a routine held in a second address register, and it returns whether the result was non-zero, and the referenced text names graphics.library.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns one and does nothing else; it takes no arguments.

name: read_global_structure_value
description: Returns zero when the structure pointer held in a global variable is null or its type byte is 7. Otherwise it returns the 32-bit field at offset 164 of the structure if that is non-zero, or else the 32-bit field at offset 442 of a nested structure reached through one of two pointer paths chosen by the type byte, returning zero when no nested pointer exists.

name: read_a1_structure_value
description: Returns zero when the type byte of the structure in address register A1 is 7. Otherwise it returns the 32-bit field at offset 164 when that is non-zero, or else the 32-bit field at offset 442 of a nested structure chosen by the type byte, returning zero when no nested pointer exists.

name: read_a1_structure_fallback
description: Returns the 32-bit field at offset 164 of the structure in address register A1 when that field is non-zero. Otherwise it picks a nested structure from offset 76 when the type byte is 1, or from the pointer at offset 56 otherwise, and returns the 32-bit field at offset 442 of it, or zero when there is no nested pointer.

name: read_value_with_a2_fallback
description: Reads the type byte of the structure in address register A1; when it is 1 it takes the nested structure at offset 76 of A1, otherwise it returns zero if address register A2 is null and otherwise takes the nested structure at offset 76 of A2. It returns the 32-bit field at offset 442 of the chosen nested structure.

name: read_nested_value_from_a2
description: Returns zero when the pointer in address register A2 is null. Otherwise it returns the 32-bit field at offset 442 of the nested structure that A2 points to at offset 76.

name: read_disk_info_entry
description: Calls one routine for a value and another for a structure, stores the value in that structure's field at offset 152, and passes a 116-byte stack buffer with a source pointer chosen by the type byte to another routine. It then calls a routine with that buffer and minus two; if the result is zero and the type byte is 1, it returns the 32-bit field at offset 442 of the nested structure and sets a global flag, and the referenced text names disk.info.

name: query_info_entry_buffer
description: Passes a 116-byte stack buffer and the pointer at offset 64 of the structure in address register A2 to another routine, then calls a routine with that buffer and minus two. If that result is zero and the type byte of the structure is 1, it returns the 32-bit field at offset 442 of the nested structure at offset 76 and sets a global flag; otherwise it returns the call result.

name: allocate_info_entry_blocks
description: Requests a 36-byte block and a 260-byte block through a routine that takes a size and flags, checking each result. It then requests a block sized from a stored value that is raised to at least 256, copies pointers and values between the blocks, and returns one only when every request and check succeeds.

name: finish_info_entry_setup
description: Stores the result of a routine call in the structure held in address register A4. When that result is non-zero and the type-byte checks and further calls succeed, it links the structures in A3 and A4, requests a block sized from a stored value raised to at least 256, copies pointers into it, and returns one; otherwise it returns zero.

name: setup_info_entry_block
description: Passes the type-byte check and one or two routine results, then links the structures held in address registers A3 and A4, sets a size field to a stored value plus one but at least 256, requests a block of that size, and copies pointers into it. It returns one when the setup completes and zero when a check fails.

name: setup_info_block_if_ready
description: If a routine call returns non-zero, it links the structures in address registers A3 and A4, sets a size field to a stored value plus one but at least 256, requests a block of that size, copies pointers into it, and returns one. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: request_sized_info_block
description: Links the structures in address registers A3 and A4 and sets a size field to a stored value plus one but at least 256. It then requests a block of that size and, when the request succeeds, copies pointers into it; it returns whether the request succeeded.

name: copy_info_fields_from_source
description: Calls another routine with a pointer read from one structure and a value read from another, copies two fields from the source structures into the destination structure, and returns one.

name: initialize_info_state_block
description: Clears five global variables and stores the second argument in a global. If an initial routine call returns non-zero, it requests a 246-byte block from a library routine and runs a sequence of setup calls on a stack-local record, reporting failure codes 1, 5, 6 or 7 through another routine when a step fails.

name: run_setup_steps_report_status
description: Runs a sequence of setup calls whose branches depend on a global pointer and on earlier results, storing a looked-up result in a field of a structure. It ends by calling a routine held in an address register with status 0 on success or with failure code 1, 5 or 7 otherwise, passing a stack-local record.

name: run_setup_steps_then_report
description: Calls a routine and stores its result, then looks up a second result and checks it against the stack-local record. A zero first result reports code 5 and a zero second result code 7 through a routine held in an address register; if a later check fails it reports code 1, and on success it runs the remaining setup calls and reports status 0 through the same routine.

name: run_short_setup_then_report
description: Looks up a value and stores it in a structure, then calls routines with a field of the structure in address register A4. A zero lookup reports status 7 and a failed later check reports status 1, both through a routine held in an address register; otherwise it calls four more routines and reports status 0.

name: finish_setup_and_report
description: Calls routines with a field of the structure in address register A4 and a value from A3. If the global pointer is null or a further check returns zero, it reports status 1 through a routine held in an address register; otherwise it calls four more routines and reports status 0.

name: check_setup_and_report
description: Calls a routine and, if it returns zero or a check on the stack-local record fails, reports status 1 through the routine held in address register A2. Otherwise it runs four more routines and reports status 0.

name: report_status_after_check
description: Calls a routine with a stack-local record and reports status 1 through the routine held in address register A2 when it returns zero. Otherwise it calls several routines, including one conditional on a global variable, and reports status 0.

name: call_subroutines_and_indirect_call
description: Calls another routine when a global variable is zero, then calls four more routines unconditionally, and finishes with an indirect call through an address register with a result code of zero and a stack-local record. It returns no value.

name: call_library_vector_132
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 132 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_138
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 138 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_198
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 198 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_210
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 210 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_246
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 246 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_294
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 294 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_372
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 372 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_414
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 414 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_552
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 552 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_42
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 42 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_96
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 96 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_228
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 228 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_366
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 366 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_72
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 72 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_234
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 234 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_270
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 270 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_354
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 354 from that base, with no return value.

name: initialize_data_block
description: Builds a block of fixed constants on the stack, including a pointer to a global variable and a value read from another global, and passes its address to another routine. If that routine returns non-zero, it calls a second routine with the result, an all-ones value and the global variable, then returns the first result; the referenced text is Info release 1.2.

name: dispatch_info_mode_action
description: Reads a 16-bit mode value from a sub-structure of the first argument and dispatches on it, calling a different routine for most modes and returning zero for modes 4 and 5 and one otherwise. Mode 5 also sets a failure flag in the global structure when a lookup returns zero.

name: toggle_mode_bit_flag
description: Maps a mode value of 6 to 9 in the second argument to a bit mask of 8, 4, 2 or 1 and XORs that mask into a flag word stored in the global structure, writing the flag back unchanged for other modes. It then calls another routine with a field from the first argument.

name: store_register_to_global
description: Stores the value in data register D1 into a field of the global structure, then calls another routine with a field from the structure in address register A1.

name: setup_info_record_checked
description: Calls a routine with a 96-byte size argument and a field of the parameter structure, and stores a value into the global structure when the type byte is 3 or 4. It runs a sequence of lookup and link calls, and when the type byte is not 1 it builds a 40-byte stack buffer and checks it; it returns one only when the final checks pass.

name: format_and_check_info_path
description: Calls an indirect routine with a field of the structure in address register A4 and a global, then runs the lookup and link sequence of the record setup routine. When the type byte is not 1 it builds a 40-byte stack buffer and returns zero if that fails; the function references the text %s%s, .info, and it returns one only when the final checks pass.

name: check_disk_path_entry
description: Passes a 40-byte stack buffer and either a global string or the pointer at offset 64 of a structure to an indirect routine, then checks the buffer against the structure and returns zero if that fails. If the check passes and the type byte is 1 it returns one; otherwise it runs two lookups and a formatting call and returns one only when those succeed, and the referenced text is Disk.

name: check_info_path_entry
description: Passes a 40-byte stack buffer and the pointer at offset 64 of a structure to an indirect routine, then checks the buffer against the structure and returns zero if that fails. If the check passes and the type byte is 1 it returns one; otherwise it runs two lookups and a formatting call and returns one only when those succeed.

name: verify_info_path_tail
description: Returns one when the type byte is 1. Otherwise it runs two lookups and a formatting call on a 40-byte stack buffer, and returns one only when those succeed, zero otherwise.

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns one and does nothing else; it takes no arguments.

name: check_info_path_pair
description: Calls a routine with a field from each of two structures and, if it returns non-zero, passes a 40-byte stack buffer with two string pointers to another routine and checks it against the second structure. It returns one only when that final check succeeds, otherwise zero.

name: format_info_path_buffer
description: Passes a 40-byte stack buffer, the referenced text %s%s, .info and two string pointers to a routine, then checks the buffer against a field of the second structure. It returns whether that check succeeded.

name: return_one_constant
description: Returns one and does nothing else; it takes no arguments.

name: call_and_check_minus_one
description: Calls a routine with the input value, a global value and minus one. If the result is not minus one it calls another routine with the input value, and it returns whether the result was not minus one.

name: call_other_and_return_one
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and then returns one. It performs no other operations.

name: initialize_info_library_tables
description: Makes a long series of calls to another routine, each with a pointer derived from the input structure, small integer flags and fixed index pairs, and the final three calls also pass a global variable. The referenced text NAME, STATUS, TYPE suggests column headings for the tables being filled.

name: configure_four_table_entries
description: Calls another routine four times with the input structure, a constant, two fixed index values and two fixed values in each call. It returns no value.

name: configure_seven_table_entries
description: Calls another routine seven times with the input structure, a flag, fixed index pairs and fixed value pairs. It returns no value.

name: register_info_table_entries
description: Calls another routine nine times with the input structure, flags, index pairs and value pairs. It returns no value.

name: set_info_table_entries
description: Calls another routine nine times with the input structure, flags, index pairs and value pairs. It returns no value.

name: choose_info_layout_calls
description: Picks a size of 154 or 131 from the type byte of the global structure, then calls another routine with either a fixed argument list or a list built from global values. It finishes by calling another routine with a field of the parameter structure and zero.

name: run_info_layout_branch
description: Calls one of two routines depending on whether the current list pointer is at its end, then calls another routine with a field of the structure in address register A2.

name: invoke_with_offset_parameter
description: Calls another routine with no arguments, then calls another routine with the field at offset 62 of the structure in address register A2.

name: allocate_info_list_entries
description: Requests a 14-byte block through a routine, links it to itself and clears a flag. If a zero-terminated list is set, it then requests a 14-byte and a 128-byte block for each entry and links them; it returns zero if any request fails and otherwise records the list head.

name: link_info_list_entries
description: Links the block in address register A3 to itself and clears a flag. It then walks a zero-terminated list of values, obtaining a block for each entry, storing a value from another routine in it and linking it, stops early when a block is null, and records the list head.

name: walk_zero_terminated_list
description: Repeatedly obtains a block through another routine for each value in a zero-terminated list, stores the list value in it and links it. It returns zero when a block cannot be obtained; otherwise it records the list head and returns the last link result.

name: link_list_entries_until_end
description: Stores a block obtained from another routine for each list value and links it, advancing through the zero-terminated list. When the list ends it records the list head and returns the last result, and it returns zero if a block is not obtained.

name: advance_info_list_cursor
description: If the current list entry is the head or its neighbour is the head, it calls one routine and then two more with the structure. Otherwise it passes the current entry and a global value to routines, moves the current entry pointer to the next entry, and calls another routine with the structure.

name: process_current_list_entry
description: Calls a routine with a value from the current list entry and a global value, then calls another routine with no arguments. It moves the current entry pointer to the next entry and calls another routine with no arguments.

name: wrap_info_list_cursor
description: If the current entry is the head or its neighbour is the head, it calls one routine and then two more with the structure. Otherwise it passes the current entry and a global value to routines, resets the current entry pointer to the first entry, and calls another routine with the structure.

name: update_global_pointer_from_list
description: Calls a routine with a value from the current list entry and a global value, then calls another routine with no arguments. It then moves the current entry pointer to the element that the current entry links to and calls another routine with no arguments.

name: insert_info_list_entry
description: Sets a flag and, when the list is not at its end, calls two routines with the current entry and global values. It then requests a 14-byte block and a 128-byte block, stores the second in the first, links the new block with the list and the current entry, makes it the current entry, and calls another routine with the first argument.

name: set_flag_and_advance_cursor
description: Sets a flag, then if the list has entries it calls routines with the current entry and a global value, moves the current entry pointer to another entry and calls another routine with the structure. When the list is at its end it calls routines with fields of the structure and zero instead.

name: pass_entry_and_advance
description: Passes the current list entry to another routine, selects the next entry as the new current entry, or the first entry when the list has ended, and calls a library routine with no arguments.

name: run_structure_callbacks_in_order
description: Calls another routine with no arguments, then calls routines with the fields at offsets 46 and 62 of the structure in address register A2, in that order.

name: build_info_pointer_array
description: When a flag is set, it either clears a pointer in the global structure if the list is empty, or counts the list entries and requests an array of four-byte slots sized to that count. It then walks the list, requesting a block per entry sized from a looked-up value or four, storing each block in the array and passing it to two routines, and it returns zero when a request fails and one otherwise.

name: fill_info_pointer_array
description: Counts the list entries, requests an array of four-byte slots for them and fills the slots by passing each entry's block to two routines. It returns zero when the array request fails and one when all entries are filled.

name: clear_info_pointer_array
description: Clears the pointer at offset 92 of the structure whose pointer is in data register D2 and returns one.

name: allocate_and_fill_slots
description: Counts the entries of the list, requests an array of four-byte slots sized to that count and stores it in the structure, then fills the slots from the list. It returns zero when the array request fails and one when every slot is filled.

name: allocate_slots_and_fill
description: Counts a zero-terminated chain of pointers through a register, requests an array of four-byte slots sized to that count and stores it in the structure, then fills the slots from the list. It returns zero when the array request fails and one otherwise.

name: fill_info_slots_from_list
description: Passes the structure's array pointer and its size to another routine, then walks the list requesting a slot per entry, sized from a looked-up value or four, and passes each slot and its entry to two routines. It returns one at the end of the list and zero when a slot request fails.

name: fill_info_slots_from_entry
description: Walks the list from the entry held in a register, requesting a slot per entry sized from a looked-up value or four, and passes each slot and its entry to two routines. It returns one when the walk reaches the end of the list and zero when a slot request fails.

name: fill_info_slots_loop
description: Repeatedly passes each slot and its list value to two routines, advances to the next list entry and requests a new slot sized from that entry's value or four. It returns one when the list is exhausted and zero when a slot request fails.

name: dispatch_layout_calls_by_type
description: Switches on the type byte of the global structure for values 1 through 6 and makes a fixed sequence of calls for each type, using constant argument pairs and values from global structures and a shared global variable. Type values outside that range make no calls.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing any work; it takes no arguments.

name: allocate_mode_buffers
description: Requests blocks of 44 and 36 bytes and two blocks sized from a stored value, then blocks of 44, 36 and two of 116 bytes, and returns zero when any request fails. Otherwise it dispatches on the type byte with a mode-specific sequence of calls and returns the result of a final routine, or the type byte itself for unlisted types.

name: run_mode_calls_indirect
description: Makes three calls through a routine held in an address register and a fourth whose result is stored at a second address register, returning zero when any of the four values is zero. Otherwise it makes one to four plain calls depending on the type byte, then a final call, and returns that call's result, or the type byte itself for other types.

name: run_mode_call_sequence
description: Makes a number of calls to another routine that depends on the type byte of the global structure: two for type 1, three for types 2 and 5, four for type 3 and five for type 4. Other types make no calls.

name: return_no_op_stub
description: Returns immediately with no operations; it takes no arguments and returns no value.

name: clear_or_copy_then_query
description: Clears the value that a global pointer refers to when a stored pointer is null, otherwise passes that pointer and a global to another routine. It then calls another routine with the first argument, a global pointer and minus one, and returns that result, or zero when the result is minus one.

name: initialize_info_library
description: Calls another routine with a pointer to a global variable and a value from the global structure, then calls a second routine and returns its result, replacing minus one with zero.

name: validate_four_entries
description: Sets a 16-bit field of four structures to fixed values unless the type byte is 4, then calls another routine with each structure and minus one. It returns one only when none of the four calls returns minus one, otherwise zero.

name: verify_three_indirect_calls
description: Calls a routine held in an address register three times and returns zero if any result is minus one, otherwise one.

name: verify_two_indirect_calls
description: Calls a routine held in an address register twice and returns zero if either result is minus one, otherwise one.

name: verify_one_indirect_call
description: Calls a routine held in an address register once and returns whether the result was not minus one.

name: return_one_immediately
description: Returns one with no other operations; it takes no arguments.

name: process_items_until_failure
description: Repeatedly takes an item from a list held at offset 86 of the first argument's structure and processes it with the second argument, returning zero when processing fails. When no item is available it calls a library routine with a bit mask shifted by a byte from the structure, and otherwise it loops without returning.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero and does nothing else.

name: dispatch_by_mode_code
description: Reads a 32-bit mode value at offset 20 of its first argument. For mode 4 it calls a routine with a field of that structure and then returns one, for mode 64 it returns the result of another routine, and for mode 512 it calls one routine and returns zero; other values run a routine on the structure and return one.

name: dispatch_mode_return_flag
description: Looks at the mode value in data register D1: for 64 it returns the result of a routine, and otherwise it calls one of two routines depending on whether the value is 512. It returns zero when the value is 512 and one otherwise.

name: call_by_mode_flag
description: Calls one of two routines depending on whether the mode value in data register D1 is 512, and returns one when it is not 512.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns with no value.

name: call_routine_then_zero
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns zero.

name: execute_two_calls
description: Calls another routine twice with no arguments and returns one.

name: execute_multiple_callbacks
description: Calls another routine three times with the structure, calls it once more when the type byte is not 1, then calls another routine with the field at offset 62 of the structure and zero, and finally calls another routine with the structure and one.

name: invoke_info_handler
description: Calls another routine with the first argument, the fixed value 3, a flag equal to bit 0 of a value in the global structure, and a pointer to a global variable. The referenced text DELETEABLE appears in the routine.

name: format_info_text_entry
description: Fills a 20-byte stack buffer by calling another routine with one of two sets of global string pointers, chosen by a flag argument. When the type argument is 3 it then calls two more routines with fixed values and that buffer; the referenced text is the pattern %s%s, NOT.

name: format_string_buffer
description: Formats a string into a stack buffer by calling another routine with global string pointers and a field of the caller's frame. It then calls two more routines when the byte in data register D2 is 3; the referenced text is the pattern , %s%s.

name: find_string_length
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string starting at the given address, stopping at the terminator, and returns the count.

name: find_zero_byte_offset
description: Increments an index held in address register A1 until the byte at the base in data register D0 plus that index is zero, then returns the index.

name: copy_cstring_to_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated byte string from the source to the destination, advancing both pointers, and includes the terminating zero byte.

name: copy_bytes_counted
description: Copies a given number of bytes from the first pointer to the second one at a time and returns nothing.

name: copy_bytes_loop
description: Copies bytes one at a time from the source in address register A1 to the destination in A0 until the index in data register D1 reaches the count in D0, copying at least one byte.

name: compare_strings_at_mismatch
description: Walks two strings in step while their bytes match and neither has ended, then returns whether the bytes at the stopping point are equal.

name: compare_two_strings
description: Advances two byte pointers in lockstep until the bytes differ or either string ends, and returns whether the current bytes are equal.

name: count_string_length
description: Walks forward one byte at a time from the given address until the zero terminator and returns the number of bytes examined, which includes the terminator.

name: process_with_offset_decrement
description: Calls another routine with the first parameter, then calls a routine held at offset 50 of the structure with the third argument and the fourth argument reduced by ten. It then calls that routine again with the second argument and once more with the fifth argument and the first result.

name: fill_local_buffer_then_call
description: Passes an 11-byte stack buffer, a global variable and the fifth argument to another routine to fill the buffer, then passes the first four arguments and the buffer to a second routine.

name: copy_length_prefixed_bytes
description: Reads a length byte from the source pointer, copies that many following bytes into the destination and writes a terminating zero after them. The routine is not reached from any known caller, so it may be gap data rather than live code.

name: copy_bytes_with_terminator
description: Copies bytes one at a time from a source address plus an index into a destination, up to an end index, then writes a zero byte after the copied range. The routine is not reached from any known caller.

name: initialize_structure_pair_then_call
description: Writes fixed and argument-derived values into two structures and links the second to the first. It then calls routines with the structures and returns whether the call with minus one as its last argument did not return minus one; only then does it call the field at offset 62 of the first structure with zero.

name: call_other_routine_with_argument
description: Calls another routine with the field at offset 62 of the structure in address register A3 and returns one.

name: clear_library_entry
description: Calls a routine held at offset 50 of the first argument's structure with the second argument, then with zero, then with the third and fourth arguments and the fifth and sixth arguments reduced by ten.

name: call_exec_raw_do_fmt
description: Calls the exec library function RawDoFmt through a library base stored at a global location and takes no arguments of its own.

name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of data register D0 to the address held in address register A3 and returns.

name: call_library_vector_36
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 36 from that base, with no return value.

name: call_library_vector_72
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 72 from that base, with no return value.

name: return_zero_entry
description: The program entry point returns zero without doing any other work.

name: store_two_values_in_structure
description: Stores two 32-bit values, one from register A6 and one from address register A0, into the structure whose pointer is in data register D0, at offsets 34 and 38.

name: increment_counter_and_clear_flag
description: Adds one to a 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure pointed to by A6 and clears bit 3 of the byte at offset 42 in the same structure.

name: decrement_counter_and_call
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure pointed to by A6; when it reaches zero and bit 3 of the byte at offset 42 is set, it returns the result of another routine, otherwise zero.

name: finish_or_mark_pending
description: If the counter at offset 32 is zero, it calls two library routines through the base at offset 34, and returns the 32-bit value at offset 38. Otherwise it sets bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 42 and returns zero.

name: get_library_value
description: Reads the 32-bit field at offset 38 of the structure in address register A5, calls two library functions at offsets minus 252 and minus 210 from the base in A6, and returns the field value.

name: return_zero_entry_stub
description: Returns zero and does no other work.

name: check_and_set_font_handle
description: Calls a library function at offset minus 84 from the base in A6 to obtain a handle; if the handle is non-zero it stores the value in A0 at offset 34 of the handle and calls another library function at offset minus 396, then returns whether the handle was obtained.

name: check_and_set_font_handle
description: Calls a library function at offset minus 84 from the base in A6 to obtain a handle; if the handle is non-zero it stores the value in A0 at offset 34 of the handle and calls another library function at offset minus 396, then returns whether the handle was obtained.

name: open_libraries_and_init_list
description: Opens two libraries through exec.OpenLibrary, the referenced text naming dos.library and graphics.library, then sets up an empty list header inside the structure in data register D0 and returns that structure. If either open fails it closes and frees the structure through library routines and returns zero.

name: close_library_and_free
description: Calls exec.CloseLibrary, then calls exec.FreeMem with the value in address register A6, and returns zero.

name: release_list_entries_and_close
description: Walks a list in the structure, unlinking entries whose counter is not positive and calling dos.UnLoadSeg on each, and decrements a count for every entry removed. When that count and a flag at offset 38 are both zero it calls exec.CloseLibrary twice and exec.FreeMem, unlinks the structure and returns the 32-bit value at offset 34; otherwise it sets bit 7 of the flag byte at offset 14 and returns zero.

name: close_and_free_when_empty
description: If the counter at offset 38 is zero and the count at offset 40 is not positive, it calls exec.CloseLibrary twice and exec.FreeMem, unlinks the structure from its list and returns the 32-bit value at offset 34. Otherwise it sets bit 7 of the flag byte at offset 14 and returns zero.

name: set_bit7_flag_return_zero
description: Sets bit 7 of the flag byte at offset 14 of the structure pointed to by A6 and returns zero.

name: return_no_op_entry
description: Returns immediately with no operations.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears bit 7 of the flag byte at offset 14 of the structure pointed to by A6 and adds one to the 16-bit counter at offset 38.

name: decrement_and_call_flagged
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 38 of the structure pointed to by A6. When the result is non-zero and bit 7 of the flag byte at offset 14 is set, it calls the library function at offset minus 18 and returns its result, otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_zero_no_work
description: Returns zero with no other operations.

name: fill_font_entries_from_flags
description: Clears the entry count and, when the first flag bit is set, writes a fixed-size record for each known font with its name. When the second flag bit is set it allocates a 260-byte buffer, scans the font directory, and frees the buffer; it returns the shortfall in bytes or zero when everything fit.

name: fill_font_list_then_scan
description: Walks the known-font list, writing a fixed-size record per font with its name copied from the list. When the second flag bit is set it allocates a 260-byte buffer and scans the font directory, and it returns the shortfall in bytes or zero.

name: copy_font_name_records
description: Copies font name characters one at a time into the output buffer, writing a fixed-size record for each completed name and moving on through the list. When the list ends it runs the optional directory scan and returns the shortfall in bytes or zero.

name: scan_font_directory_entries
description: When the second flag bit is set, it allocates a 260-byte buffer, locks the FONTS: directory and examines its entries with Examine and ExNext. For each file whose extension matches the referenced .font text, it copies the name and attributes into the output records, checks a 16-bit marker value, and then unlocks the directory and frees the buffer.

name: continue_font_directory_scan
description: Continues the font directory scan from the current entry, writing name bytes and a fixed record for each matching .font file, and returns the shortfall in bytes or zero once the scan ends.

name: read_font_file_records
description: Reads the next bytes of a font file through the Read routine and checks a four-byte header for a 16-bit marker value. For each matching entry it writes a fixed-size record, continues the directory scan, and returns the shortfall in bytes or zero.

name: read_font_records_and_close
description: Reads font file entries through the Read routine, writing a record for each header that carries the marker value and copying the name bytes that follow. When the scan ends it closes the file through the Close routine and returns the shortfall in bytes or zero.

name: unlock_and_return_shortfall
description: Unlocks the directory through the UnLock routine, calls a library function at offset minus 420, and returns the shortfall in bytes or zero.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Immediately returns zero without performing any other operations or accessing memory.

name: compute_match_score
description: Returns a large negative sentinel when the reference size is zero; otherwise it computes a score from the size difference, scaled by its sign and offset by a fixed value. It then subtracts one table weight for each of seven flag bits that differ between the two structures.

name: subtract_differing_flag_weights
description: Starts from a value derived from the second argument and a 16-bit term, then subtracts one table weight for each of seven flag bits that differ between the two structures, and returns the result.

name: subtract_masked_flag_weights
description: Walks seven flag bits, subtracting the table weight for each bit that is set in the mask and matches a flag byte of the structure in address register A1, and returns the running total.

name: subtract_flag_weights_by_mask
description: Walks seven flag bits in a different order from its sibling routines, subtracting the table weight for each bit whose mask applies to the flag bytes of the structure in address register A1, and returns the running total.

name: return_negative_sentinel
description: Returns minus 32767 as a sentinel value and does no other work.

name: select_best_font_entries
description: Copies seven bytes from the first argument into a local record, looks up a value through two routines, and reads the FONTS: directory. It then repeatedly selects the highest-scoring entry from a table of 260-byte blocks, links entries with a matching type value into the font list and increments the list count, until no entry beats the threshold; it returns the last stored pointer.

name: select_font_entries_by_score
description: Locks the FONTS: directory through two routines and reads its entries into a table of 260-byte blocks, using a second argument for comparison when present. It then repeatedly selects the highest-scoring entries, linking those with a matching type value into the font list, until no entry beats the threshold, and returns the last stored pointer.

name: continue_font_selection_loop
description: Continues the selection loop over the table of 260-byte blocks, choosing the highest-scoring entry each time and linking matching entries into the list. When no entry beats the threshold it releases the working buffers and returns the last stored pointer.

name: scan_font_candidates_loop
description: Scans the candidate table for the highest-scoring entry, looking up a comparison value when a second argument is present. Entries with a matching type value are linked into the font list and their counts updated, and when no candidate remains the working buffers are released and the last stored pointer is returned.

name: clear_and_select_font_entries
description: Clears the table entry that was just selected, then continues choosing the highest-scoring remaining entries, linking those with a matching type value into the font list and clearing the others. It returns the last stored pointer once no entry beats the threshold.

name: select_and_close_font_entries
description: Repeatedly chooses the highest-scoring table entries and links those with a matching type value into the font list. When no entry beats the threshold it unlocks and closes the directory and file handles through library routines, and it returns the last stored pointer.

name: call_exec_forbid
description: Calls exec.Forbid through the library base stored at a global location and returns no value.

name: call_exec_permit
description: Calls exec.Permit through the library base stored at a global location and returns no value.

name: call_exec_alloc_mem
description: Calls exec.AllocMem through the library base stored at a global location and returns no value.

name: call_exec_free_mem
description: Calls exec.FreeMem through the library base stored at a global location and returns no value.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes one at a time from the source to the destination, including the terminating zero, and stops once that zero has been copied.

name: seek_string_end_then_call
description: Advances to the terminating zero of the string and then calls another routine with that position and the second argument. The routine is not reached from any known caller.

name: call_routine_and_return_stub
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns with no value. The routine is not reached from any known caller.

name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string from the given address and returns the count, not including the terminator.

name: return_no_op_void
description: Returns immediately with no operations.

name: compare_strings_ordered
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, returning minus one when the first sorts before the second, one when it sorts after, and zero when they are equal.

name: compare_byte_before_pointer
description: Compares the byte before the address in A1 with the byte at address A0 and returns minus one when the first is smaller, otherwise one.

name: find_char_in_string
description: Searches a zero-terminated string for the given byte and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or null when it is not present.

name: find_char_after_pointer
description: Starts one byte past the address in A0 and searches forward for the byte in data register D0, returning its address or null if the terminator is reached first.

name: return_zero_unused_stub
description: Returns zero and does no other work. The routine is not reached from any known caller.

name: find_last_char_in_string
description: Finds the length of the zero-terminated string and searches backward from its last byte for the given byte, returning the last occurrence or null if there is none.

name: find_char_backward_bounded
description: Searches backward from the address in A0 down to the lower bound in D3 for the byte in D2, returning its address or null when the bound is passed.

name: return_zero_gap_stub
description: Returns zero with no other operations.

name: find_path_separator
description: Returns the address of the first slash in the string if there is one, otherwise of the first colon, otherwise the start address of the string.

name: return_void_stub
description: Returns immediately with no operations.

name: call_handler_and_return
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns with no value; it is a handler entry point in the library.

name: call_handler_routine_stub
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns with no value.
